description: A PROFILING probe, not a modelling run: four iterations at the campaign fraction on the F30 stack with the JVM's own flight recorder and GC log on (RUN.machine.jfr_profile, RUN.machine.gc_log), read afterwards by src/analyse/profile_run.py. Nothing produced under it is a reading of any mode. It exists because the iteration's decomposition stops at MATSim's stopwatch: the F28 gate's 258.5 s splits into mobsim 168 s, replanning 50 s and prepareForMobsim 34 s, and every cut proposed against those three numbers since 9.142 has been REASONED - a String here, a parse there - because no instrument ever said which method inside them was hot. The recorder samples every thread's stack, so the three phases decompose to the pool and the method, and the next cut is chosen on a measurement instead of a reading of the source. The recording is OBSERVATION: JFR samples threads that are running anyway and writes its own file, so a profiled run and an unprofiled one are the same run and this overlay opens NO family. Iterations 1-3 are the comparison window (0 pays JIT warm-up, and a profile taken during warm-up describes the compiler rather than the model). Graph rendering OFF (9.59). Heap left at the campaign's declared 40g so the profile describes the arm's own conditions; the 31g compressed-oops question is a SEPARATE probe with the same overlay and --set RUN.machine.xmx=31g.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: The declared sweep starts at 250 because that is the largest value MEASURED to be insufficient for convergence (DECISIONS.md 9.7), so the whole range describes candidate MODELLING runs. This overlay is not one: it profiles the wall-clock cost of an iteration, and four iterations are the window that measurement needs (0 warms up, 1-3 compare). The value is deliberately far below the range so that any output carrying it is obviously not a result. Same reasoning as f27_timing_probe_25pct (9.147).
